{{Top|leg}}
A '''Droid search scope Type 1''' was a detector that aided [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in scanning for traps or other security measures. This version was the most basic and therefore least expensive, though successful detection depended mostly on the complexity of the device to be detected.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
